key_figures.question: Q1
key_figures.input: replayed Vstay over schedule steps for three greedy policies
key_figures.why_draw: shows when/where peak forms, not only final max
key_figures.supports: policy changes lifetime overlap and peak behavior
key_figures.cannot_prove: global optimality or cross-workload superiority from one workload
key_figures.better_or_complement: add shared y-scale and mark peak step/value for all six workloads
key_figures.use_when: schedule/order decisions change resource occupancy trajectory

key_figures.question: Q1
key_figures.why_draw: shows marginal gain and saturation under search budget
key_figures.supports: some graph families have more remaining search room
key_figures.cannot_prove: fair optimizer ranking unless evaluation counts/runtime/seeds are matched
key_figures.better_or_complement: median+IQR over seeds with wall-clock x-axis
key_figures.use_when: stochastic refiner is proposed over deterministic baseline

key_figures.question: Q1
key_figures.cannot_prove: the paper's specific O(N log N)/O(N^2) claims when E/evaluation count are omitted
key_figures.better_or_complement: empirical runtime vs N/E plus fitted slope
key_figures.use_when: algorithm choice depends on contest runtime budget

key_figures.question: Q2
key_figures.input: best and mean fitness by generation for graph families
key_figures.why_draw: shows search stabilization and population behavior
key_figures.supports: optimizer reached a plateau on fitted graph families
key_figures.better_or_complement: held-out graph performance vs deterministic baseline

key_figures.question: Q3
key_figures.supports: best_fit dominates first/worst in shown Conv0 comparison
key_figures.cannot_prove: global best rule across all workloads
key_figures.better_or_complement: small multiples across all six cases and error bars/seeds
key_figures.use_when: allocator strategies are compared on multiple objectives

key_figures.question: Q3
key_figures.input: feasible candidate transfer/time pairs + convergence history
key_figures.why_draw: shows nondomination, correlation and search convergence
key_figures.supports: existence/shape of tradeoff if points are feasible and registry-consistent
key_figures.cannot_prove: best deployment point without an explicit selection rule; cannot survive table inconsistencies
key_figures.better_or_complement: highlight infeasible points/cap line, chosen point, hypervolume/spacing across seeds
key_figures.use_when: multiobjective search genuinely returns multiple feasible operating points

layout_lessons: algorithm-heavy paper uses flowcharts/pseudocode before result curves
Q1 evidence sequence: graph/data exploration → greedy trajectories → stochastic convergence → final table/complexity
Q2 evidence sequence: rule representation → fitness convergence → allocator table → final table
Q3 evidence sequence: method schematic → strategy dashboard → Pareto/convergence → operating-point tables
style_lesson: learn evidence density and ordering; do not copy fixed blue styling or decorative radar charts when a direct 2-D tradeoff plot is clearer
